lines.en: Tomas, finally! How long have you been waiting here at the station?

lines.en: I’ve been waiting since seven o’clock. The train to Providence has been running late again.
lines.pt: Estou esperando desde as sete. O trem para Providence está atrasado de novo.

lines.en: That’s more than an hour! Have you been standing the whole time?

lines.en: Mostly. I’ve been walking around for twenty minutes because the benches are full.
lines.pt: Quase. Estou andando por aí há vinte minutos porque os bancos estão cheios.

lines.en: I’ve been trying to call the ticket office, but nobody has been answering the phone.
lines.pt: Estou tentando ligar para a bilheteria, mas ninguém está atendendo o telefone.

lines.en: They’ve been making announcements for an hour, and I don’t understand a word. The speakers are terrible.
lines.pt: Eles fazem anúncios há uma hora, e eu não entendo uma palavra. Os alto-falantes são péssimos.

lines.en: Well, I’ve been watching the screen since I arrived. It says the train will leave in ten minutes.
lines.pt: Bem, eu observo o painel desde que cheguei. Ele diz que o trem sai em dez minutos.

lines.en: It has been saying that for the last forty minutes, Idris. How long have you been standing here?
lines.pt: Ele diz isso há quarenta minutos, Idris. Há quanto tempo você está aqui?

lines.en: Only since half past eight. I’ve been talking to a woman who has been waiting even longer than you.
lines.pt: Só desde as oito e meia. Estou conversando com uma mulher que espera há mais tempo ainda que você.

lines.en: Then let’s ask her what she knows. How long has she been sitting at that gate?
lines.pt: Então vamos perguntar o que ela sabe. Há quanto tempo ela está sentada naquele portão?

lines.en: Good idea. If the train never comes, we have been waiting long enough to ask for a refund!
lines.pt: Boa ideia. Se o trem nunca vier, esperamos tempo suficiente para pedir reembolso!

facts.label: Present perfect contínuo
facts.sub: Há quanto tempo: How long have you been waiting? Período: for an hour. Ponto de partida: since seven. Forma: have/has been + -ing.

facts.label: Há / durante
facts.sub: Use for com um período: for an hour, for three days, for ages. I’ve been waiting for an hour. Ele diz quanto tempo dura a ação até agora, e a ação ainda continua ou acabou de parar.

facts.label: Desde
facts.sub: Use since com um ponto de partida: since seven, since Monday, since I arrived. I’ve been waiting since seven. Não use since com um período como two hours.

pages.title: A very long wait at the station · 1/3
paragraphs: It is half past nine on a cold Saturday morning in Boston. The main station is crowded with tired travellers. A loud voice announces another delay. Dan has been sitting near the gate since seven. His friend Blake finally walks in with two coffees. They both want to know how long this will take.

“Dan, finally! How long have you been waiting here at the station?” says Blake. “I’ve been waiting since seven o’clock. The train to Providence has been running late again.” says Dan. “That’s more than an hour! Have you been standing the whole time?” says Blake.
